sentence: Reads are on graph typed KnowledgeGraph in buildDomainOverview/buildDomainDetail and on node typed GraphNode (getDomainMeta parameter and elements of graph.nodes), so edges, nodes, domainMeta, summary and filePath are genuine reads of both shapes.
At lines 567-571 node is an element of filteredGraphNodes derived from the store graph.nodes (GraphNode[]), and the same fields are read again from node: GraphNode at line 933ff.
prepareLayout(graph: KnowledgeGraph) reads graph.edges, graph.layers and graph.nodes directly from the typed parameter.

Receivers are node: GraphNode and graph: KnowledgeGraph parameters (FigmaThumbnail, KnowledgeNodeDetails, DomainNodeDetails) plus node found in the store graph.nodes, and all cited fields including figmaMeta exist on GraphNode.
buildGraphIndexes(graph: KnowledgeGraph) reads graph.nodes and graph.layers and getSortedTour(graph: KnowledgeGraph) reads graph.tour.
graph: KnowledgeGraph is read for layers and edges, and e iterates edges: GraphEdge[] in aggregateContainerEdges where e.source and e.target are read.
filterEdges iterates edges: GraphEdge[] and reads edge.source and edge.target on each element.
detectCommunities iterates edges: GraphEdge[] and reads e.source and e.target.
buildChatContext(graph: KnowledgeGraph) reads graph.nodes, graph.edges, graph.layers and graph.project directly.

edge iterates edges destructured from graph: KnowledgeGraph (GraphEdge[]) and targetNode comes from ctx: ExplainContext whose targetNode is GraphNode, so source, target, filePath, lineRange and languageNotes are genuine reads.
partial is the parameter of a callback typed OnUpdateCallback = (partial: AgentToolResult<SubagentDetails>) => void, and partial.details and partial.content are read.
outcome is declared let outcome: AgentToolCallOutcome and outcome.isError and outcome.durationMs are read.
createToolDefinitionFromAgentTool(tool: AgentTool<any>) reads tool.outputSchema, tool.prepareArguments, tool.executionMode and tool.execute, all declared on AgentTool.

AgentToolCallOutcome reads and result.content/structuredContent are genuine, but the cited AgentToolResult usage read at line 727 is on result of type TResult extends ModelCallResult, an unrelated type.
result is declared let result: AuthResult | undefined and result.auth and result.env are read.
resolution is the awaited value of this.models.getAuth(), which returns Promise<AuthResult | undefined>, and resolution.env and resolution.auth are read.
result is declared AuthResult | undefined (auth, env read) and withConfiguredAuth takes auth: ModelAuth (headers, apiKey read).
remoteModels(entry: ModelsStoreEntry | undefined) reads entry.lastModified and entry.models.
describeProvider(modelRuntime, provider: Provider) reads provider.auth, provider.baseUrl and provider.headers.

The cited signal read at line 256 is on options: CreateModelRuntimeOptions in create(), not on ModelsRefreshOptions, although providers and allowNetwork in refresh() and the ModelsRefreshResult reads are genuine.
base is a parameter typed Provider | undefined (auth, baseUrl, headers read) and context is the parameter of Provider.refreshModels, contextually typed RefreshModelsContext (signal, credential read).
context is the parameter of refreshModels in an object returned as Provider, so it is RefreshModelsContext, and stored, allowNetwork, signal and force are read from it.
refreshModels is declared async (context: RefreshModelsContext) and reads context.stored, allowNetwork, signal and credential.
publication is typed ModelsPublication explicitly at line 165 and contextually via RefreshModelsContext.publish at line 119, and persist and update are read.
publish is declared (publication: ModelsPublication) and reads publication.persist and publication.update.
fauxProvider is declared const fauxProvider: FauxProviderRegistration and api, models, setResponses, appendResponses, getPendingResponseCount and unregister are read from it.
The cited role and content reads are on message elements of agent.state.messages and context.messages (an AgentMessage/Message union) narrowed to user or system, not on an AssistantMessage.
content is read on a parameter typed AssistantMessage | ToolResultMessage and role on agent.state.messages[2] (AgentMessage union), so neither receiver is typed as AssistantMessage itself.

Several cited AssistantMessage reads are on other values: content at line 1931 is on msg from result.messages (extension custom messages) and role at line 820 is on context.messages elements of the AgentMessage union.
describeModel(model: Model<Api>) reads reasoning, contextWindow, maxTokens, samplingParams, compat and thinkingLevelMap, all declared on Model.
Receivers are casts to AssistantMessage (assistantMsg, assistant), a cast to SystemMessage (system), and calculateContextTokens(usage: Usage), covering every cited field.
addUsageToTotals(usage: Usage) and combineUsage(first: Usage, second: Usage) read input, output, cacheRead, cacheWrite, cacheWrite1h, reasoning, totalTokens and cost.
The cited AssistantMessage role and content reads at lines 3810-3812 are on getUserMessageText(message: Message) narrowed to role user, not on an AssistantMessage.
The cited reads are on context.messages elements filtered to role user, so message.content is read from a user message, not an AssistantMessage.
readOps is the return value of createGondolinReadOps(): ReadOperations, and readOps.readFile and readOps.access are read.
canResizeFromSides(editorInterface: EditorInterface) reads editorInterface.formFactor and editorInterface.userAgent.
this.editorInterface is a class field declared editorInterface: EditorInterface, and canFitSidebar, desktopUIMode, formFactor and isTouchScreen are read from it.
renderLinkIcon takes renderState: ElementRenderState and reads renderState.offset and renderState.opacity in the same function.
_renderBinding takes binding: FixedPointBinding and reads binding.fixedPoint and binding.elementId.
The repair function takes binding: FixedPointBinding | null and, after the null check, reads binding.fixedPoint, binding.mode and binding.elementId.
el is typed DebugElement in render() (color read) and in the filter over window.visualDebug.data, declared DebugElement[][] (permanent read).
data is declared const data: ImportedDataState and data.elements and data.appState are read.
renderConfig is a parameter typed StaticCanvasRenderConfig in isPendingImageElement, drawElementOnCanvas and renderElement, reading imageCache, theme and isExporting.
excalidrawAPI is a prop typed ExcalidrawImperativeAPI and setActiveTool and setCursor are read from it.
excalidrawAPI is state from useState<ExcalidrawImperativeAPI | null>, null-checked before addFiles, getSceneElements, getAppState, getFiles, setViewport and the other cited reads.

appState is a parameter typed Partial<AppState> (exportBackground, viewBackgroundColor) and excalidrawAPI comes from useExcalidrawAPI() over a context typed ExcalidrawImperativeAPI | null or from opts typed ExcalidrawImperativeAPI.
this.excalidrawAPI is a class field typed CollabProps["excalidrawAPI"], which is ExcalidrawImperativeAPI, and all cited methods including onUserFollow and onScrollChange are declared there.
excalidrawAPI is a prop typed ExcalidrawImperativeAPI and getAppState and getFiles are read from it.
appState is a parameter typed AppState in render() and _debugRenderer, reading zoom, scrollX and scrollY.
makeQuad(topLeft: Point, bottomRight: Point) reads topLeft.x and topLeft.y.
findFocusedNode(node: SerializedAXNode | null) reads node?.focused and node?.children.

Configuration reads on configuration: Configuration are genuine, but the ChromeSettings reads of downloadBaseUrl and skipDownload are on configuration[browser] and defaultConfig, which are typed as the union ChromeSettings | ChromeHeadlessShellSettings | FirefoxSettings rather than ChromeSettings.

skipDownload at line 71 is read from configuration returned by getConfiguration() (Configuration, not ChromeSettings) and downloadBaseUrl at line 39 is read from a parameter typed as a three-way settings union.
defaultBrowserOptions is declared const defaultBrowserOptions: LaunchOptions and args, executablePath and extraPrefsFirefox are read from it.
